rename.from: Observability for HTTP Server - when http route is / then it tag http.route is not sent
rename.to: Observability for HTTP Server - when http route is / then attribute 'http.route' is not sent

issue.title: Fix http.route tracing attribute reporting
issue.body:
We know properly report the root path
whereas previously it was being ignored

Fixes: #34778

body:
> according to [OTEL semantic conventions of HTTP Server](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/trace/semantic_conventions/http/#http-server-semantic-conventions) the attribute `http.route` is required

While we can provide the route for this case, I would like to clarify that it may not always be the case, so it is not exactly required. It is only required if available.
